$comment: Endpoints this repository is allowed to send requests to.
SECURITY.md requires each one to be chosen by reading its provider's data
policy. This file records what was read and when; it cannot verify that the
policy still says so. A stale entry is a prompt to re-read, not evidence.
An agent that reads repository contents must not use an endpoint whose
provider may train on submitted content.
